review.body: { use nrz_cas :: { Rational , limits :: Budget } ; use pn_records :: wall :: Verdict ; if bound . inputs () . 1 != self . procedure || self . procedure . fence . as_ref () . is_none_or (| p | ! p . inverse_wall) { return Err (Error :: Scope) ; } let (prepared , _) = crate :: fence :: prepare (bound) ? ; let mut b = Budget :: new (self . procedure . enclosure . as_ref () . ok_or (Error :: Scope) ? . operation . clone ()) ? ; if Rational :: parse (& prepared . width , & mut b) ? != Rational :: parse (& self . input . width , & mut b) ? || Rational :: parse (& prepared . cumulative_tilt , & mut b) ? != Rational :: parse (& self . input . cumulative_tilt , & mut b) ? { return Err (Error :: Scope) ; } let checked = self . replay (record) ? ; let branches = checked . branches . as_ref () . ok_or (Error :: Scope) ? ; if checked . indecisive || branches . above_floor != Verdict :: Pass || branches . policy_valid != Verdict :: Pass { return Err (Error :: Scope) ; } Ok (bound . with_enclosed_wall (branches . delivered . clone ()) ?) }
review.item_premise: The complete public reference definition and checked record bind to the immutable compiled support; only public rational wall bounds are retained, with no price mutation or secret input.
